name: pdf-summarizer
description: Extract, summarize, and query PDFs with citations and page references.
longDescription: Give your agent a reliable way to read long PDF files, extract tabular datasets, and return structured summaries with citations.
author: paperplane
readmeMarkdown:
# PDF Summarizer

Give your agent a reliable way to read long PDF files and return structured summaries with citations.

### Installation

```bash
skillpm install paperplane/pdf-summarizer
```

### What it can do

- Extract text from local and remote PDF files
- Return summaries with page-level citations
- Answer questions using only the supplied document

### Usage

```typescript
agent.use("pdf-summarizer", {
  file: "./annual-report.pdf",
  format: "brief"
})
```
